MUTUAL RELEASE AND WAIVER OF CLAIMS

This Mutual Release and Waiver of Claims (this "Release") is entered into as of April 22, 2026, by and between Pelagic Freight Systems, Inc., a Washington corporation ("Pelagic"), and Kanaan Brothers Produce, LLC, an Arizona limited liability company ("Kanaan"). Pelagic and Kanaan are each a "Party" and together the "Parties."

RECITALS

A. Pelagic and Kanaan were parties to a Transportation Services Agreement dated March 1, 2023 (the "Prior Agreement"), under which Pelagic hauled refrigerated produce for Kanaan.

B. Disputes arose between the Parties concerning cargo temperature excursions on eleven shipments between June and September 2025, Kanaan's withholding of $412,880 in freight charges, and Pelagic's assertion of a carrier's lien (collectively, the "Disputes").

C. The Prior Agreement terminated by its own terms on February 28, 2026, and neither Party has any continuing obligation to the other under it except as stated in this Release.

D. Without any admission of liability by either Party, the Parties wish to resolve the Disputes fully and finally on the terms below.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual releases and the payment described below, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows.

1. Payment.

Within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date, Kanaan shall pay Pelagic $265,000 by wire transfer to the account Pelagic designates in writing. The payment is a compromise of disputed claims and is not an admission of liability.

2. Release by Kanaan.

Kanaan, on behalf of itself and its predecessors, successors, assigns, parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, members, managers, employees, agents, attorneys, and insurers, hereby fully and finally releases and forever discharges Pelagic and its predecessors, successors, assigns, parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, shareholders, employees, agents, attorneys, and insurers from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, losses, damages, costs, and expenses of every kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, liquidated or contingent, at law or in equity, arising out of or relating to the Prior Agreement, the Disputes, or the shipments described in Recital B, in each case arising at any time on or before the Effective Date.

3. Release by Pelagic.

Pelagic, on behalf of itself and the same categories of related persons listed in Section 2, hereby fully and finally releases and forever discharges Kanaan and the same categories of related persons from any and all claims of the same scope described in Section 2, in each case arising at any time on or before the Effective Date. This release includes Pelagic's carrier's lien, which is released and discharged in full on receipt of the payment described in Section 1.

4. Release of Unknown Claims.

Each Party understands that it may later discover claims or facts in addition to or different from those it now knows or believes to exist with respect to the matters released in this Release, and that those claims or facts may have materially affected its decision to enter into this Release. Each Party nevertheless assumes that risk and agrees that this Release remains effective in all respects notwithstanding the discovery of any such claim or fact. Each Party expressly waives any and all rights it has or may have under any statute or common-law principle that would limit the effect of a general release to claims known or suspected to exist at the time of execution, including without limitation Section 1542 of the California Civil Code, which provides: "A general release does not extend to claims that the creditor or releasing party does not know or suspect to exist in his or her favor at the time of executing the release and that, if known by him or her, would have materially affected his or her settlement with the debtor or released party."

5. Claims Not Released.

Nothing in this Release releases (a) any obligation created by this Release itself; (b) any claim arising from acts or omissions occurring after the Effective Date; (c) any claim that cannot be released as a matter of law; or (d) any right either Party has to enforce a final judgment entered in a proceeding to enforce this Release.

6. No Admission.

This Release is a compromise of disputed claims. Neither the execution of this Release nor the payment made under it is an admission by either Party of any liability, wrongdoing, or the validity of any claim or defense, and this Release shall not be admissible in any proceeding except one to enforce its terms.

7. Covenant Not to Sue.

Each Party covenants that it will not commence, prosecute, or assist in the prosecution of any action against the other Party asserting any claim released by this Release. If a Party breaches this covenant, the breaching Party shall pay the other Party's reasonable attorneys' fees and costs incurred in defending the action and in enforcing this Section.

8. Representations.

Each Party represents that it has not assigned or transferred any claim released by this Release, that the person signing on its behalf is duly authorized to do so, that it has had the opportunity to consult counsel of its own choosing, and that it enters into this Release voluntarily and with full knowledge of its terms.

9. Confidentiality.

The Parties shall keep the terms of this Release confidential and shall not disclose them to any third party except to their attorneys, accountants, auditors, insurers, and lenders on a need-to-know basis and bound to confidentiality, or as required by law, regulation, or court order. If disclosure is compelled, the disclosing Party shall give the other Party prompt written notice, to the extent legally permitted, so that the other Party may seek a protective order.

10. Governing Law and Venue.

This Release is governed by the laws of the State of Washington, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles. The Parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in King County, Washington, for any proceeding to enforce this Release.

11. Entire Agreement; Amendment; Counterparts.

This Release is the entire agreement of the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior negotiations and understandings concerning it. It may be amended only by a writing signed by both Parties. It may be executed in counterparts, and an electronic signature has the same effect as an original.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Release as of the date first written above.
